explained.text: The Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA shall support STANAG3350, RGB, VGA, DVI, and ARINC818 interfaces.
explained.explanation:
**Meaning :** The Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA must be capable of handling five specific types of data interfaces: STANAG3350, RGB, VGA, DVI, and ARINC818.

**Components :**
- Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA

**Parameters :**
- STANAG3350
- RGB
- VGA
- DVI
- ARINC818

explained.text: 2.1 Features VITA 42 Compliant XMC Module; Kintex Ultrascale series FPGA with two 4GB DDR4 SDRAM controller; x8 PCIe Gen 3 links on XMC Primary Connector; Dual mode displayport video input; 2x Single link DVI outputs on XMC Secondary Connector (FG configurable); 1x Single link DVI output on DVI Connector at Front panel (FG configurable); 3x ARINC 818 Transmitter(Tx & Rx) on XMC Secondary Connector (FG configurable); RGBHV / VGA / STANAG 3350 Output using Encoder on XMC Secondary Connector (FG configurable)
explained.explanation:
**Meaning :** This requirement describes a VITA 42 compliant XMC module built around a Kintex Ultrascale series FPGA. It details the module's memory, connectivity, and configurable video/data output capabilities.

**Components :**
- VITA 42 Compliant XMC Module
- Kintex Ultrascale series FPGA
- 4GB DDR4 SDRAM controller
- x8 PCIe Gen 3 links
- XMC Primary Connector
- XMC Secondary Connector
- Dual mode displayport video input
- Single link DVI outputs
- DVI Connector at Front panel
- ARINC 818 Transmitter (Tx & Rx)
- RGBHV / VGA / STANAG 3350 Output Encoder

**Parameters :**
- Two 4GB DDR4 SDRAM controllers
- x8 PCIe Gen 3 links
- 2x Single link DVI outputs (XMC Secondary Connector, FG configurable)
- 1x Single link DVI output (Front panel, FG configurable)
- 3x ARINC 818 Transmitters (XMC Secondary Connector, FG configurable)
- RGBHV / VGA / STANAG 3350 Output (XMC Secondary Connector, FG configurable)
